company_description: The single most important finding is that ORCHVATE clearly operates as an active commercial brand with an official website (orchvate.com) describing neurodiversity-focused hiring programs and data-annotation services, but the fetched evidence contains no authoritative record tying that brand to a UK-incorporated legal entity. Overall confidence in the brand-level observations is High (direct website and social evidence); confidence that a UK legal entity exists is Low-to-Medium because Companies House or other UK registry records were not found in the fetched material. The key open uncertainty is the legal-entity mapping: whether a UK-registered company, branch, or subsidiary exists under a different name and is simply not disclosed on the brand's public pages.

sources.title: Fetched content from https://www.orchvate.com/Our-Journey.html
evidence: When we started placing NDs in corporates, we were flooded with applications and enquiries ...
we discovered Dataloop ... they let us use it for free for a whole quarter. If billed, this would have been in the 1000s of dollars.
Taskmonk, an Indian data annotation platform, stepped up.
Microsoft soon accepted us into their Startups program and gave us free Azure credits.
we connected to iMerit ... our group was on the iMerit L &D platform being tested for their annotation skills. All did well scoring over 90% in record time
We featured at the NASSCOM AI Summit
